rules.title: Required notice form accompanying a notice to quit for nonpayment of rent
rules.requirement: If your landlord gives you a written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent, it must come with a state form listing any repayment agreements, rental assistance programs (such as RAFT), court rules, and eviction protections, and stating that the notice is not an eviction. A court cannot accept the landlord's nonpayment eviction filing without proof that this form was delivered to you.

coverage.summary: All residential tenants in Massachusetts who receive a written notice to quit for nonpayment of rent.

rules.penalty: No court, including the Boston municipal court department, may accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint in a nonpayment eviction without proof of delivery of the required form.
rules.quoted_span: No court having jurisdiction over an action for summary process pursuant to chapter 239, including the Boston municipal court department, shall, in an eviction for nonpayment of rent for a residential dwelling unit, accept for filing a writ, summons or complaint without proof of delivery of the form required under this section.

notes: This section is a notice-to-quit disclosure requirement for nonpayment evictions, not a just-cause requirement; it was classified under just_cause_eviction because that category covers eviction notice rules. The document does not state an effective date. The form is developed by the Executive Office of Housing and Livable Communities.
